questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is**** ****free from error, select 'No Error'.** 

Agriculture was the key development, whereby farming (1)/ of domesticated species creation food (2)/ surpluses nurturing the development of civilisation. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** '2' i.e. error lies in this part of the sentence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**In part 2 of the sentence,** the usage of **'creation'** is incorrect Instead, use **'created'**

 
• **Let's understand the sentence**→ The subject of the sentence is **'Agriculture'** and *'was' is the linking with the linking verb we usually write a subject complement hence 'the key development' is the subject complement.*
 
• **'Whereby' is conjunction** hence we know that the conjunction makes a clause and the clause always have its own subject in the given sentence the subject is 'Farming' which is singular in number. 
 
• So, we need a verb that should be in the past tense to follow the parallelism. 'Creation' is a noun hence we don't need a noun here.

**So the correct sentence is** → *Agriculture was the key development, whereby farming of domesticated species** created** food surpluses nurturing the development of civilisation.*

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.** 

Some modern anthropologists hold 

P : that biological evolution has shaped 

Q : not only human morphology 

R : but also human behaviour
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'PQR'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• First comes **P **as begins with 'that', indicating that it is a subordinating clause and continues the opening sentence.
 
• '**Not only.. but also' **is a **correlative conjunction.**
 
• It is used for stressing that there is something more to be added. 
 
 
• Example - Mary not only studies hard but she also works well. 
 
 
 
• Therefore, according to the above points, **Q **must come before** R**.
 
• Hence,** Only Option 2, i.e. PQR **is a possible answer.

*The correct sentence - ****Some modern anthropologists hold that biological evolution has shaped not only human morphology but also human behaviour. ***

questions.question: If 9*8 = 144, 7*7 = 98 and 7*8 = 112, then the value of 5*1 = ?
questions.solution:
The pattern here is as follows, two numbers are given separated by ‘*’. We get the answer by multiplying the two numbers and again multiplying the result by 2 to get the answer.

Let A and B are two numbers such that A*B then

A*B = (A × B) x 2 i.e.

9*8 = (9 × 8) x 2 = 72 × 2 = 144

7*7 = (7 × 7) x 2 = 49 × 2 = 98

7*8 = (7 × 8) x 2 = 56 × 2 = 112

Similarly, 5*1 = (5 × 1) x 2 = 5 × 2 = 10.

Hence, 10 is the correct alternative.

questions.question: X and Y can do a piece of work in 10 days, Y and Z in 12 days and Z and X in 15 days. In how many days can Z alone do the work?

**Given:**

No. of days X and Y take to complete a work = 10

No. of days Y and Z take to complete a work = 12

No. of days Z and X take to complete a work = 15

**Formula used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

(1 day work of X) + (1 day work of Y) = 1/10 ----(1)

(1 day work of Y) + (1 day work of Z) = 1/12 ----(2)

(1 day work of Z) + (1 day work of X) = 1/15 ----(3)

Adding (2) and (3), we get,

⇒ (1 day work of X) + (1 day work of Y) + 2(1 day work of Z) = 1/12 + 1/15 = 3/20

Substituting (1), we get,

⇒ 1/10 + 2(1 day work of Z) = 3/20

⇒ 2(1 day work of Z) = 3/20 – 1/10 = 1/20

⇒ 1 day work of Z = 1/(20 × 2) = 1/40

**∴ Z will alone do the work in 40 days**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Let the total work = LCM (10, 12, 15) = 60

Efficiency of Z + X = 60/15 = 4 units/day

Efficiency of 2(X + Y + Z) = 15 units/day

Now, Efficiency of Z = 7.5 - 6 = 1.5 units/day

Z alone do the work = 60/1.5 = 40 days

questions.question: The olfactory receptors in human beings detect ________.

**__CONCEPT:__**

__
 
• **Receptors** are the organs or cells which respond to light, heat, or external stimulus and transmit the signal to the sensory nerve.
 
• The smell receptors known as chemoreceptors are present in the **Olfactory Epithelium **in the nose.
 
• Olfactory receptors are located in our noses.
 
• The olfactory system allows the human body to detect and process smell.
 
• These are also known as smell receptors and are capable of binding odor molecules.
 
• Most of the olfactory receptors are found on the superior or external surface of the nasal cavity.
 
• Olfactory receptors are present in the nose and are responsible for giving rise to the sense of smell.

**EXPLANATION:**__

Olfactory epithelium:

 
• The olfactory receptors in human beings detect smell.
 
• Olfactory receptors are proteins that exist as clusters at the back of the nasal cavity and interact with odor molecules thus playing a role in smelling.

 
• The organ of smell is a yellow-tinged patch of the pseudostratified epithelium (olfactory epithelium) located on the roof of the nasal cavity.

questions.question:
Fe₂O₃ + 2Al ⟶ Al₂O₃ + 2Fe

The above reaction is an example of ________.
questions.solution:
__Concept:__

Chemical Reactions:

__
 
• A process in which one or more compounds are formed as products completely different from the reacting substances is known as a chemical reaction.
 
• There is generally a change in heat, colour, or appearance when a chemical reaction takes place.
 
• The evolution of gas may also occur.
 
• A chemical reaction may be reversible or irreversible in nature.

Types of Chemical Reactions-

The basis for different types of reactions is the product formed, the changes that occur, the reactants involved, and so on. Different types of reactions are

 
• Combustion reaction
 
• Decomposition reaction
 
• Neutralization reaction
 
• Precipitation or Double-Displacement Reaction

Neutralization reaction:

 
• The reaction of an acid with a base to give salt and water is called a neutralization reaction.
 
• Example is:

NaOH (strong base) + HCl (strong acid) → ​NaCl + H2O

Oxidation reaction:

 
• Oxidation Reaction refers to a reaction in which either the addition of Oxygen takes place or the removal of Hydrogen takes place.
 
• It can also be said as the process of loss of one or more electrons by atoms or ions.
 
• Example is:

Mg + O2 = Mg2O

Reduction Reaction:

 
• Reduction Reaction refers to a reaction in which either the addition of Hydrogen takes place or the removal of oxygen takes place.

 
• In the process of reduction, a chemical species also gains electrons.
 
• It is the reverse of the oxidation reaction.
 
• Example is:

H2 + F2 → HF

Exothermic reaction:

 
• It is a type of reaction where heat or energy is produced.
 
• For example, in the synthesis of ammonia from nitrogen and hydrogen.

N2 + 3H2 → 2NH3

Explanation:__

A chemical reaction in which a less reactive element is displaced from its compound by a more reactive element is known as a __**displacement reaction.**__

 
• In the given reaction Fe (Less reactive element) of Fe₂O₃ gets displaced by Al (More reactive element).

questions.question: Where is New Moore Island located?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **New Moore Island**__ was a small, uninhabited island located in the Bay of Bengal.
 
• The island was off the coast of the Ganges-Brahmaputra delta, approximately 2 km from the mouth of the Hariabhanga river.
 
• Also known as South Talpatti, the island emerged in 1970 after cyclone Bhola.
 
• It disappeared in 2010 due to rising sea levels.

questions.question: Who is the exponent of Continental Drift Theory?
questions.solution:

• While the idea was first presented by Abraham Ortelius in 1596, the full, developed theory was given by Alfred Wegener in 1912.
